faqs.question: How does the Skilliant Escrow Guarantee system protect contractors?
faqs.answer: Skilliant holds labour payments in a secure Escrow wallet. Funds are only transferred to the Labour Crew Lead after work milestone verification or weekly attendance sign-off, eliminating fraud and site payment disputes.

faqs.question: What is the process to request additional certified labour during site emergencies?
faqs.answer: Use the 'Quick Hire Labour' button on your dashboard or call our 24/7 Site Emergency Hotline (+91 1800 233 8899). Skilliant dispatches verified standby crews within 4 to 6 hours.

faqs.question: How do I download tax-compliant GST invoices for labour payouts?
faqs.answer: Navigate to the Wallet & Payments section, locate any transaction under Transaction History, and click 'View Invoice'. You can view, print, or download official PDF invoices directly.

faqs.question: What documents are required to maintain a 100% Contractor Trust Badge?
faqs.answer: Contractors must maintain valid GST Registration, Labour License (R&A Act), Workmen Compensation Insurance Policy, and Director KYC documents.
